text:
sahil: Quick heads-up — finance pushed the pricing policy rollforward to go live next Tue. Need clarity on how POC discounts map to the new fee schedule.

jess: Ack. Do we have a canonical mapping doc? I still see old % tiers in my quotes.

sahil: Not yet public. Finance gave a short table but didn’t include POC carve-outs.

leah: Important: a couple of enterprise POCs have signed LOIs that reference the old SLA/discounts. Do we grandfather?

omar: For those LOIs we usually honor the effective discount for 90 days after go-live. We should confirm with legal though.

jess: Can we get a quick ruling from deal desk? deal-desk-bot, any guidance on exception flow for pre-existing POCs? :eyes: 

deal-desk-bot: @jess Please submit an exception request via /deal-exception with LOI attached. Approvals required: Sales Lead + Revenue Ops. Typical turnaround 48 hours.

sahil: Copy. For quoting: is it safe to attach a short note that says "pricing subject to new fee schedule effective <date>"? Trying to avoid confusion.

omar: Yes, add that clause. Also we should include a POC-specific footnote: "POC discounts apply only to non-production evaluation usage and expire on conversion or 90 days."

leah: Related ask — a SOC/infosec questionnaire for a healthcare prospect is blocking a POC. If we add a special term (data residency + higher support), does that affect discount tiers?

jess: Usually yes. Extra compliance/work requires discount reduction or a separate line item. If support is premium, we bill as add-on.

omar: Agree. We should avoid mixing discounts with compliance concessions. Propose: keep base POC discount, add a compliance surcharge line item so revenue ops can track.

sahil: Good idea. Can someone draft a short template stanza we can paste into quotes? e.g.,
```
POC terms: Evaluation discount applies only to non-production usage for up to 90 days. Any additional compliance or residency requirements will be invoiced as separate professional services or support add-ons.
```

jess: That looks fine. Minor edit: replace "90 days" with dynamic field when LOI specifies different term.

leah: I'll make the template flexible. Also flagging: we need a changelog entry in the internal ratebook so CS and TAMs are aware. Where should that live?

omar: Put it in /docs/sales/ratebook/changelog and ping #sales-product for visibility. I'll open a GH PR after the exception policy is confirmed.

sahil: One last thing — can revenue ops confirm whether existing committed annual customers who upgrade during the transition keep old unit pricing? If not, we need to prepare a rollback plan.

deal-desk-bot: @sahil Route: /deal-exception -> tag "grandfathering". Revenue Ops will triage. For committed customers: default = preserve existing contract pricing unless amendment submitted.

jess: Awesome. Action items:
- leah: draft quote stanza + flexible 90-day placeholder (ETA EOD)
- omar: open ratebook changelog PR once exception flow confirmed
- sahil: include clause in upcoming customer comms
- sales: use /deal-exception for LOIs referencing old terms

leah: On it. Will post the draft here when ready. :white_check_mark: 

sahil: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for POC/exception coordination.
